theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+2.30%) and Real Estate (+1.19%) led the market today, while Health Care (-0.50%) and Technology (-0.36%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.19%, defensives +0.16%, and value/cyclicals +1.22% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.27%, Dow +0.31%, Nasdaq -0.63% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +0.73%, outperforming large caps. The VIX rose 7.32% to 28.29, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold added 1.72% to $3,610.20, crude oil was little changed at $84.10, and bitcoin gained 0.53% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
